analysisBase: same MMLU-ProX source questions, test split, English and Hindi economics
cohort: frozen structural audit, same English source-group partitions, excludes option, digit and Roman-statement discrepancies before opening scores
primary: Hindi minus English strict majority full-plan correctness among compatible configurations
strict: more than half the fixed committee must agree on a valid canonical option
calibrationTies: prefer larger minimum count when utility is tied
reliabilityWeight: integer numerator correct+1 from Laplace-smoothed full-plan accuracy on each language calibration split, with shared denominator calibration n+2
agreementCalibration: Laplace correctness prediction conditional on the number of members who support the plurality choice and on a valid plurality
additionalComparisons: descriptive. Existing English holdout outcomes are retrospective. The Hindi holdout remained unopened before this local registration.
confidence: observable agreement only, no expressed model confidence
sensitivity: all seven, including Olmo with a known cross-language configuration difference, strict majority only.
